item.title: Google Cloud us-west1 down
item.summary: No info on GCP's public status page, but the personalized status page shows this: August 20, 2026 at 8:53:16 AM UTC-7 We are investigating a multi-product issue in us-west1 region. Description: We are investigating a potential issue with Persistent Disk, Google Kubernetes Engine, Google Compute Engine, Cloud Run, Google Cloud Bigtable. We will provide more information by Thursday, 2026-08-20 09:20 PDT. Workaround: No workaround published Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49376696 Points: 10 # Comments: 4
